title: Review an acquisition-date consolidated balance sheet — Pratt and Selby
instructions: On December 31, Pratt Corp. acquired 90% of Selby Co. for $1,800,000 cash. A staff accountant prepared the acquisition-date consolidated balance sheet amounts. Review them against the acquisition data. Tick every amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount.

exhibits.title: Acquisition data
exhibits.content:
| | Pratt (before acquisition) | Selby book value | Selby fair value |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Inventory | 350,000 | 210,000 | 260,000 |
| Land | 600,000 | 300,000 | 500,000 |
| Customer relationships (not recorded by Selby) | — | — | 100,000 |
| Selby's identifiable net assets | | 1,500,000 | 1,850,000 |
| Common stock | 500,000 | 400,000 | |
| Retained earnings | 2,400,000 | 1,100,000 | |

Fair value of the 10% noncontrolling interest at December 31: **$190,000**. Pratt's retained earnings already reflect the **$45,000** of legal fees for the deal, which Pratt expensed.

rows.label: Goodwill
rows.explanation: Goodwill = consideration 1,800,000 + fair value of NCI 190,000 − fair value of identifiable net assets 1,850,000 = **140,000** (full goodwill, ASC 805-30-30-1). The draft computed only the parent's share.

rows.label: Noncontrolling interest
rows.explanation: NCI is measured at acquisition-date **fair value**, **190,000** — not 10% of Selby's book value.

rows.label: Customer relationships intangible
rows.explanation: An identifiable intangible meeting the contractual-legal or separability criterion is recognized apart from goodwill at fair value, even though Selby never recorded it: **100,000**.

rows.label: Common stock
rows.explanation: Only the parent's equity survives; Selby's equity is eliminated. **No error.**

rows.label: Retained earnings
rows.explanation: Parent only (acquisition-related costs were already expensed by Pratt). **No error.**

parts.prompt: Identify the correct treatment of each item.

rows.label: $45,000 of legal and due diligence fees for the acquisition
$30,000 of registration costs for shares issued as part of a later financing
rows.explanation: Costs of issuing equity securities reduce the proceeds (APIC).

rows.label: Selby's customer relationships
rows.explanation: Separately identifiable intangible — recognized apart from goodwill.
